invented.quote: This is the first update you've had from me in six months.
invented.why: Skipping the last two quarterly updates means it has been roughly nine months (three quarters) since the previous update, not six months.

invented.quote: That's the biggest competitive threat we face: a records system that comes with a scheduler that's good enough.
invented.why: The brief only states that one customer moved to the scheduler in their electronic records system, not that this is the company's biggest competitive threat.

invented.quote: so this is the result our customers feel most directly.
invented.why: The brief gives the no-show rate reduction but does not state how customers feel about it or how it compares to other features.

invented.quote: The reminders are the part of the product with the clearest, most measurable result.
invented.why: The brief does not mention the other parts of the product or whether their results are clear or measurable.

invented.quote: Selling them separately at $150/month means a clinic can buy them without giving up the scheduler it already has, including one built into its records system. That gives us a product to offer the kind of customer we just lost, instead of having to win them away from software they already have.
invented.why: The brief does not explain why the reminder feature is being sold separately or state that it can integrate with third-party or built-in electronic records schedulers.
The brief does not give the founder's name.
